PRESIDENT'S ORDER 2 OF 2003
PRESIDENT'S ORDER
2 OF 2003
SUPREME COURT
JUDGES (LEAVE PENSION AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2003
An order further
to amend the Supreme Court Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges) Order, 1997
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 2nd December, 2003]
F.No.2(2)/2003-Pub., dated 2-12-2003.--The
following order promulgated by the President is hereby published for general
information:--
Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the Supreme Court Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges) Order, 1997,
(P.O.No.2 of 1997), for the purposes hereinafter appearing.
Now, therefore, in exercise of
the powers conferred by the Fifth Schedule to the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make the following order:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This order may be called the Supreme Court judges
(Leave, Pension and Privileges) (Amendment) Order, 2003.
(2) it shall coma into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on and from the first day of
July, 2003.
2. Amendment of paragraph 20,
P.O. No.2 of 1997.--In the supreme Court Judges (Leave, Pension and
Privileges) Order, 1997 (P.O.No.2 of 1997), hereinafter referred to as the said
Order, in paragraph 20, in sub paragraph (2), for the words "twenty-five thousand"
the words "twenty-eight thousand seven hundred and fifty" shall be
substituted.
3. Amendment of paragraph 22,
P.O.No.2 of 1997.--In the said order, in paragraph 22, for the words
"seven thousand" the words "eleven thousand" shall' be
substituted.
